tools.name: flow_artifact
tools.label: artifact
tools.description: Read one bounded binary window from a retained command artifact owned by this run. Results are base64 encoded and never interpreted as text.

reference.description: Opaque artifact reference returned by Flow command evidence.

tools.name: flow_edit
tools.label: edit
tools.description: Atomically edit one existing UTF-8 workspace file using its flow_read SHA-256 version and exact, unique, non-overlapping replacements. Stale versions fail without automatic merging.

edits.description: Exact, unique, non-overlapping replacements matched against the same original content.

oldText.description: Exact, non-empty text that occurs once in the current file.

expectedSha256.description: Full SHA-256 version returned by flow_read for this file.

path.description: Path to one existing UTF-8 file inside the Flow workspace.

tools.name: flow_exec
tools.label: exec
tools.description: Execute one bounded executable and literal argument vector in Flow's production sandbox. No shell, environment overrides, cwd overrides, stdin, PTY, background mode, or network access are available.

args.description: Literal argument vector passed without shell expansion (default: empty).

executable.description: Executable name or path. Shell syntax is not supported.

tools.name: flow_ls
tools.label: ls
tools.description: List workspace directory contents alphabetically, including dotfiles and '/' suffixes for directories. Output is bounded to 500 entries by default and 50 KiB.

path.description: Directory to list (default: current workspace directory).

tools.name: flow_read
tools.label: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the Flow execution workspace or an explicitly selected immutable skill:// resource. Workspace results include a full-file SHA-256 version for flow_edit. Binary and image decoding is not supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

tools.name: flow_semantic
tools.label: semantic
tools.description: Query one operator-selected language server for bounded diagnostics, definitions, references, or hover information. The tool cannot edit files or run model-selected commands.

character.description: Zero-based character for definition, references, or hover.

line.description: Zero-based line for definition, references, or hover.

path.description: Portable path to one admitted project file.
